# `csharp_blank_lines_after_using_list`

Blank lines below the last using directive.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini

```
